mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, it is 42 degrees with clear skies by the Military Ridge State Trail and a first quarter moon. If you are up early, you can catch the ISS passing almost directly overhead at 4:57 AM, moving from the direction of Mount Horeb toward the Fitchburg and Madison area.

The city of Verona is promoting a new Stormwater Utility Credit. Residents can lower their utility bills by using sustainable practices like rain barrels or infiltration systems. In other news, the police department recently released a statement regarding the arrest of a school bus driver last week.

There is plenty to do in town today, including Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, you can look forward to trivia at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and a fun Wednesday pizza and pitcher night at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. No students were injured, and the case remains under investigation.
Today's flavor of the day is the rich and delicious Devil's Food Cake. The store is closed right now but will open today at 10:00 AM.
